sql: SELECT "film"."film_id" AS k, (CAST("film"."rental_rate" AS REAL) / "film"."rental_duration") AS m1 FROM "film" WHERE (CAST("film"."rental_rate" AS REAL) / "film"."rental_duration") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: film.rental price per allowed rental duration
why: rental price / allowed rental duration: the catalogue declares rental price a rate over allowed rental duration
rank film rows by rental price per allowed rental duration

sql: SELECT "film"."film_id" AS k, ("film"."rental_rate" - "film"."replacement_cost") AS m1 FROM "film" WHERE ("film"."rental_rate" - "film"."replacement_cost") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: film.rental price minus one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged)
why: rental price - one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged): both in USD and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one film
rank film rows by rental price minus one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged)

sql: SELECT "film"."film_id" AS k, (CAST("film"."rental_rate" AS REAL) / "film"."replacement_cost") AS m1 FROM "film" WHERE (CAST("film"."rental_rate" AS REAL) / "film"."replacement_cost") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: film.rental price relative to one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged)
why: rental price / one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged): a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank film rows by rental price relative to one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged)

sql: SELECT "film"."film_id" AS k, (CAST("film"."replacement_cost" AS REAL) / "film"."rental_rate") AS m1 FROM "film" WHERE (CAST("film"."replacement_cost" AS REAL) / "film"."rental_rate") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: film.one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged) relative to rental price
why: one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged) / rental price: a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank film rows by one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged) relative to rental price

sql: SELECT "film"."film_id" AS k, (CAST(("film"."replacement_cost" - "film"."rental_rate") AS REAL) / "film"."rental_rate") AS m1 FROM "film" WHERE (CAST(("film"."replacement_cost" - "film"."rental_rate") AS REAL) / "film"."rental_rate") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: film.relative difference of one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged) from rental price
why: (one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged) - rental price) / rental price: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
rank film rows by relative difference of one-time asset value of a physical film copy (charged if lost or damaged) from rental price
